connection-setup.description: Only the bundled Drclick connection page may choose where this installation's data lives: keep it on this PC, or attach to a Cabinet Hub or Cloud endpoint.

desktop-windows.description: The Drclick application window may invoke signed-updater commands and read which machine owns this installation's data. It is granted no offline-restore, LAN, Google OAuth, opener, shell, or filesystem capability, and it cannot change the data owner.
